notes: Mobile root and child panels measured from the existing public browser page, including header, fluid type tokens, margins, back button, and external arrow.
Menu content comes from the MkDocs navigation tree, not OpenAI's product categories.
Latin fonts are downloaded locally. Chinese chapter labels retain the site's system-font fallback.

Header search and sidebar SVGs are reconstructed inline from the visible controls: direct icon downloads and browser asset export were unavailable. The back and external-link SVG paths are reused from the delivered DOM. Explicit fill=none on each outline shape prevents Material's fill rule from making solid icons.
The drawer stays available up to Material's desktop breakpoint (1220px), so tablet article navigation remains accessible.
